messages.author: b099dfcfdf95dbcf
messages.subject: runEMclonalCN unknown instruction code error
parts:
Hello,
I get the following error when executing titanCNA R code:

convergeParams <- runEMclonalCN(data,gParams=params$genotypeParams,nParams=params$normalParams, pParams=params$ploidyParams,sParams=params$cellPrevParams,maxiter=20,maxiterUpdate=1500,txnExpLen=1e15,txnZstrength=1e5, useOutlierState=FALSE,normalEstimateMethod="map",estimateS=TRUE,estimatePloidy=TRUE)

fwdBack: Iteration 1 chr: Error in codeBufCode(cb) : unknown instruction code
Calls: runEMclonalCN ... %dopar% -> <Anonymous> -> comp -> genCode -> codeBufCode
In addition: Warning messages:
1: executing %dopar% sequentially: no parallel backend registered
2: In fun(libname, pkgname) : bytecode version mismatch; using eval
Execution halted

Would be helpful for any pointers on how to debug this - all packages were compiled under the same version of R so I am puzzled as to why the error happens.
I've checked and all input seem to be valid - data object exists with all component present, etc.

R version 3.1.2 (2014-10-31)
Platform: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu (64-bit)

other attached packages:
 [1] TitanCNA_1.6.0       Rsamtools_1.18.3     Biostrings_2.34.1
 [4] XVector_0.6.0        GenomicRanges_1.18.4 GenomeInfoDb_1.2.5
 [7] IRanges_2.2.7        S4Vectors_0.6.6      BiocGenerics_0.14.0
[10] foreach_1.4.2

GCC_PATH=/illumina/thirdparty/gcc/gcc-4.9.2

Best,

messages.author: 71cefeaaa3659875
messages.subject: Re: runEMclonalCN unknown instruction code error
parts:
Hi,

The inference step using forwards-backwards algorithm (fwdBack) analyzes each chromosome in parallel.  It appears that you have included 24 chromosomes, presumably including chrY.  I would recommend that you not analyze chrY.  You can use the filterData function to specify the chromosomes to analyze.

Hope this helps,
Gavin
